business_summary: NKK Switches Co., Ltd. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of various switches for industrial. It offers toggle, rocker, pushbutton, illuminated pushbutton, multi-function pushbutton, emergency stop, key lock, rotary, slide, tactile, and tilt switches; indicator lights; relays; sheet keyboards; touch panels; and accessories, as well as universal design products. The company's products are used in information and communication equipment, space satellite equipment, computers, FA automation equipment, aviation, railways, ships, medical care, disaster prevention, measurement and control equipment, semiconductor-related equipment, amusement, mobile communication, health and environment, and other fields, as well as involved in the medical and semiconductor materials. The company was formerly known as Nihon Kaiheiki Ind. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NKK Switches Co., Ltd. in April 2014. NKK Switches Co., Ltd. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Kawasaki, Japan.
business_summary_ko: NKK Switches Co., Ltd.는 다양한 산업용 스위치를 개발, 제조, 판매하고 있습니다. 토글, 로커, 푸시버튼, 조명 푸시버튼, 다기능 푸시버튼, 비상 정지, 키 잠금, 회전식, 슬라이드, 촉각 및 틸트 스위치를 제공합니다. 표시등; 릴레이; 시트 키보드; 터치 패널; 액세서리, 유니버설 디자인 제품까지. 당사의 제품은 정보통신기기, 우주위성기기, 컴퓨터, FA자동화기기, 항공, 철도, 선박, 의료, 방재, 계측제어기기, 반도체 관련기기, 오락기기, 이동통신, 보건환경 등의 분야에 사용되며 의료 및 반도체 소재에도 적용됩니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Nihon Kaiheiki Ind. Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2014년 4월에 NKK Switches Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. NKK Switches Co., Ltd.는 1951년에 설립되었으며 일본 가와사키에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
